name: databasin
description: Databasin MCP workflows for governed data discovery, schema exploration, SQL planning, and bounded read-only analysis.

interface.longDescription: Use Databasin's fixed-purpose MCP tools to discover authorized resources, browse schemas, read approved semantic context, inspect aggregate profiles, validate read-oriented SQL plans, and manage bounded asynchronous query operations. Connector, pipeline, and automation changes remain planning-only unless a separately governed capability is enabled.
